blocks: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:
Section 10005 of the Elections Code is repealed.
digest: Existing law prohibits local governments from enacting or enforcing any charter provision, ordinance, or regulation requiring a person to present identification for the purpose of voting or submitting a ballot at any polling place, vote center, or other location where ballots are cast or submitted.
This bill would repeal that prohibition.
label: Introduced
subject: Elections: voter identification.
title: An act to repeal Section 10005 of the Elections Code, relating to elections.
